examples.japanese: {太陽|たいよう}が{真上|まうえ}にある。
ヘリコプターが{真上|まうえ}を{飛|と}んでいる。
examples.english: A helicopter is flying right above.

examples.japanese: {私|わたし}の{部屋|へや}の{真上|まうえ}には{隣人|りんじん}の{部屋|へや}がある。
examples.english: My neighbor's room is directly above my room.

notes:
{真上|まうえ} combines {真|ま} (true, direct) with {上|うえ} (above), meaning "directly above" with no deviation.

Related directional words:
- {真下|ました} (directly below)
- {真横|まよこ} (directly beside)
- {真|ま}ん{中|なか} (right in the middle)
- {真正面|ましょうめん} (directly in front)

Usage:
- {真上|まうえ}に (directly above)
- {真上|まうえ}から (from directly above)
